title: Build List Keys
prompt: A React list needs stable keys for rendered rows. Write a helper that returns each item id as a string. If an item has no id, use "fallback-" followed by its index.

explanation.beginner:
Example: buildListKeys([{"id":"a","label":"A"},{"id":2,"label":"B"}]) produces ["a","2"]. The result must follow this precise rule: A React list needs stable keys for rendered rows. Write a helper that returns each item id as a string. If an item has no id, use "fallback-" followed by its index. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “falls back to index”: input [[{"label":"A"},{"label":"B"}]] produces ["fallback-0","fallback-1"]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
